name: Digital Documentary
tagline: Investigations that open like films and read in daylight.
idea: The homepage behaves like the opening of a documentary: a full-bleed film frame, a title card and a timeline that doubles as chapter navigation. Dark, graded imagery carries the emotion; every long read moves onto a light bone page for easy reading.
fit: Your strongest material is testimony and long investigations. Supporters can enter through a four-minute film, while journalists and researchers get a calm, accessible reading page with findings and downloads.
informedBy: Immersive report pages with a photo hero, chapters and downloads.
Video features with a poster frame and a clear play control.
A serif reading face for long text, sans-serif for the interface.
distinct: The only film-led concept: a chapter timeline, timecodes, letterboxed frames and graded imagery on near-black, balanced by light bone reading pages.
buttons: Square uppercase buttons (ember Donate, bone primary, outlined secondary), an amber play control and amber-underlined links.
imageDirection: Letterboxed, cinematic crops with a warm-dark grade, film grain and scrims behind text; captions on key frames; people only in silhouette.
navigation: Slim transparent bar over the film frame with Watch and ember Donate; a sticky Watch bar on mobile.
visualCharacter: Cinematic and dark, with calm bone reading pages
contentEmphasis: Flagship investigations, short films, chaptered storytelling
bestFor: Organisations with strong photography and video that want investigations to feel urgent and immersive.
tradeoffs: Needs good imagery and regular short films; dark pages feel heavier and suit flagship stories more than routine news.
